cues.en:
Everyone gathered in the plaza in front of GGF!
And everyone across the country watching this broadcast!

The biggest Gundam event in history,
"Gundam Great Front",

This event, held under the theme
"The Gundam World Becomes Reality"...
Its most popular part of all was...

the live event using the Gunpla Battle Simulator,
"Battle Live-G"!

The many heated battles of the players
that you all watched

will surely be told for years to come
as new great scenes of the Gundam world!

Now, to close Gundam Great Front,
as the grand finale,

we begin an exhibition match
by the selected players of "Battle Live-G"!
